 🔴LIVE: 2 students, teacher stabbed at Warrenton middle school 
 By First Alert 4 Staff Published : Nov. 12, 2026 at 8:38 AM CST | Updated : 51 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WARRENTON, Mo. (First Alert 4) - Three people were stabbed at Black Hawk Middle School Thursday morning, according to the Warrenton Police Department.
 The department told First Alert 4 that a juvenile male suspect who was a student at the school stabbed two students and a teacher with a 4-5 inch blade. The stabbing happened inside a classroom around 7:55 a.m., and there were no threats before the incident.
 Autoplay One of the students who was stabbed was flown to a St. Louis children’s hospital, and the teacher was taken to the hospital via ambulance. The Warren County Ambulance District said that both were in serious condition. 
 “We are aware of the incident at Black Hawk Middle School and are prepared to provide care to any patients who may require medical attention. Our thoughts are with everyone affected by this situation,” read a statement from SSM Cardinal Glennon.
 A second student had “superficial wounds,” according to police.
 According to police, there is no threat to the public and a suspect is in custody.
 The scene remains active. Police said as of 10:41 a.m., all classrooms have been cleared. Officers and school officials are still working to return students to their parents.
 The Warren County R-III School District said all schools in the district will dismiss at 12:41 p.m., and all Black Hawk Middle School sports have been canceled.
 According to the Center for Education Safety, Missouri’s primary statewide school safety organization and clearinghouse for emergency planning and preparedness, Warren County R-III requested Behavior Threat Assessment and Management Training last spring. 
 First Alert 4 is working to determine whether Warren County R-III has completed the training or if it is still being arranged by the state. 
 First Alert 4 has reached out to the police department, the Warren County R-III School District, and the Warren County Sheriff’s Office for further information.
 This is a developing story; First Alert 4 will provide updates as they come in.
